description: This file defines a fragment named CatalogFragment for an Android application, responsible for displaying a product catalog with filtering, sorting, search, and recent search functionalities. It manages UI components such as RecyclerView, search input, category chips, and sorting options, and interacts with a data repository to fetch products, categories, and persist user preferences.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of products with filtering, sorting, search, and recent searches features.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores preferences, sets up event listeners, and loads initial data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up pending runnables to prevent memory leaks when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: setupDebouncedSearch
methods.description: Configures a text watcher on the search input to debounce user input before triggering product refresh.

methods.name: setupSortDropdown
methods.description: Initializes the sorting options spinner with labels and selection handler.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Dynamically creates category filter chips based on available categories.

methods.name: refreshProducts
methods.description: Fetches, filters, sorts, and displays products based on current filters and search query.

methods.name: sortOptionToSpinnerPosition
methods.description: Converts a sort option enum to the spinner position index.

methods.name: sortKeyToSortOption
methods.description: Parses a sort key string to the corresponding SortOption enum.

methods.name: persistCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Saves current category and sort preferences to persistent storage.

methods.name: restoreCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads and applies persisted category and sort preferences.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Filters a list of products based on selected category and search query.

methods.name: applySorting
methods.description: Sorts a list of products based on the selected sort option.

methods.name: matchesSearch
methods.description: Checks if a product matches the current search query based on name or category.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic relevance score for sorting products when relevance is selected.

methods.name: setupRecentSearchesUi
methods.description: Configures the clear button for recent searches.

methods.name: renderRecentSearches
methods.description: Displays recent searches as clickable chips.

methods.name: applyRecentSearch
methods.description: Sets the search input to a recent query and triggers a search.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility to convert density-independent pixels to pixels.
